sources.label: Morphe patches for FreeZona
sources.author: Zona
patch_list: Disables internal event tracking, ClickHouse telemetry, crash reporting, and AppMetrica SDK to enhance privacy and battery life.
Switches to landscape orientation when movie or series playback starts.
Installs the patched app beside the original one under its own package name and app name, so the original keeps updating on its own.
Plays at the quality from "Preferred quality" instead of the last quality chosen by hand, and waits for preferred quality sources before falling back.
Increases ExoPlayer video buffer duration to eliminate stutter and rebuffering on slow connections.
